adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts the BookingReference fields written from the create results were changed from `credentialId: isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` to `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly in the later mapping). That means for non-calendar integrations (e.g., video conferencing where `isCalendarType` is false), newly created references will no longer persist `result.credentialId` at all. This is a correctness regression in the diff itself; whether handleCancelBooking.ts relies on `bookingVideoReference.credentialId` to delete meetings is not shown in this diff, but the diff does clearly drop credentialId persistence for video references, which can orphan external meetings if deletion logic needs that id.
